## Teaching points

1. Jaw claudication and transient visual loss warrant immediate glucocorticoid treatment and specialist assessment to protect vision.
2. Threatened vision calls for immediate treatment and urgent ophthalmology/rheumatology assessment; diagnostic confirmation must not delay treatment.
3. Inflammatory markers support but do not independently establish the diagnosis. Arterial imaging/biopsy and subsequent steroid management require specialist follow-up.
